verdict.rationale: Warp says it offers an API (warp-docs-42), and a probe found an OpenAPI spec at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json (warp-docs-2 probe). But a machine-readable spec is not an interactive, explorable API reference with runnable examples, and no evidence documents a try-it console, playground or executable samples. The axis applies to a product that exposes an API, so the lack of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
